meta_description: KRB Decorating is a trusted painter and decorator in Sheffield. Interior and exterior work, wallpapering, and finishing. Local, reliable, competitive rates.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Local Painter & Decorator — Sheffield Since 2012
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and finishing that transforms your home. No mess, professional results, competitive pricing.
services_subhead: From interior walls and ceilings to exterior rendering and woodwork, we handle every decorating job with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork painted to a flawless finish. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality paints, and work around your schedule with minimal disruption.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior paint and varnish for fascias, soffits, doors, and shutters. We use proven products and techniques to protect your home from Sheffield's elements.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging on any wall type. Pattern matching, straightness, and seamless finishes — we make it look effortless.

services.title: Artexing & Texture Finishes
services.desc: Artex ceilings, stippled finishes, and decorative textures applied by hand with precision. Perfect for covering imperfections or achieving a specific look.

services.title: Woodwork & Doors
services.desc: Interior and exterior doors, skirting, architrave, and window frames painted or varnished to last. We sand, prime, and finish for a professional appearance.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office, retail, and industrial spaces redecorated on time and within budget. We plan work around business hours and clean as we go.

about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every home looking better than I found it.
about_para_1: KRB Decorating has been serving Sheffield homeowners and businesses for over 14 years. Founded on the belief that decoration should be affordable, reliable, and hassle-free, we've built our reputation by showing up on time, doing the job right, and treating every room like it matters. Our team combines traditional techniques with modern materials to deliver finishes that last.
about_para_2: We're repeat business people — most of our work comes from referrals and customers who call us back. We listen to what you want, give honest advice on colours and materials, and take pride in clean, careful work. Whether it's a bedroom refresh or a full commercial repaint, we approach every project with the same level of attention and professionalism.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About KRB Decorating

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. Karl was professional, punctual, and the finish is flawless. He moved furniture carefully, protected the carpets, and cleaned up every day. No fuss, no mess. Highly recommend him.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen done and the transformation is amazing. Karl was friendly, knew exactly what he was doing, and finished bang on schedule. The walls are smooth and the colour looks perfect. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Came to paint the exterior of our rental property. Professional, efficient, and very tidy. Sorted the whole job in 4 days. Fair price too. Karl knows his stuff and gets on with it without any drama.
reviews.author: James P.
